about: The five hall lobby maps, read from the editor maps Lobby_<Map>_SBO.umap by a tool kept outside the repo (the umaps are not in the repo; source.sha256 names the file each map was read from).

Markers: X, Y, Z in cm and Yaw, Pitch in degrees, as placed in the editor. A spot's floor is the Pawn collision floor the editor measured under it; tools/sbo_lobby_rows.py puts the spot at the higher of the marker and that floor, plus 100 cm.
A seat's Z is the seat top; seat_cm is the height of the seat top above the floor in each sit loop (decoded clips, about 1 cm error). A seat with skip is left out of the mod, with the reason.

A seat's approach is where EVE stands up: X, Y and the Pawn floor under the seat marker, where the editor traced her standing capsule clear. It is 60 cm along the seat's yaw when that point is clear, else the nearest clear point on that line, else the nearest cell of the walkable flood fill whose floor is within 5 cm of that Pawn floor; rule names the one used. tools/sbo_lobby_rows.py puts it at that Pawn floor plus 100 cm.
fence: centre X, Y and radius R from a flood fill of the editor maps (25 cm cells), zmin 200 cm under the lowest floor, zmax the lowest roof volume over the walkable area.
